description: This file defines the interface 'FieldConfigInterface' for configurable field definitions in Drupal, extending other interfaces and declaring methods for setting labels, descriptions, translatability, settings, default values, constraints, and validation rules.

classes.name: FieldConfigInterface
classes.description: An interface for configurable field definitions in Drupal, extending FieldDefinitionInterface and ConfigEntityInterface, with methods for managing field labels, descriptions, settings, default values, constraints, and validation.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the field.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets a human-readable description for the field.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is translatable.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets multiple settings for the field without unsetting existing ones.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting by name.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the field is required.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for computing the default value.

methods.name: setPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Sets constraints for a specific property of the field.

methods.name: addPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Adds constraints to a property of the field.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a validation constraint to the FieldItemList or property.

methods.name: setConstraints
methods.description: Sets multiple constraints for the FieldItemList, overwriting existing ones.
